Yet another game I missed out on for a long time because of all the backlash. I'm not sure I ever saw anything positive said about it; the only reason I tried it out is because it has local coop on PC.

And surprise surprise, it turns out to be a very nice little game.

The best way to describe it would be as a cheap DLC for a superior cover-to-cover shooter: enemy variety is low, weapon variety is low, no melee, no sprint, no vaulting unless it allows you to reach another cover, etc. The plot is equally low-stakes: a botched evacuation and a rescue mission, further cementing its status as a budget game.

And yet it is a lot of fun to play. Sure it is neither great nor imaginative, but what it does, it does well. The gameplay is fast and smooth, the graphics are very good considering the potato hardware it can run on, the plot makes the most of its limited runtime, and the level design is quite competent: the on-foot levels are largely oriented towards coop, with rock-paper-scissors weaknesses and obvious weak spots that require circling and flanking if you have no explosives available.

Coop will require at least one controller, although both players using controllers is possible.

The easy mode is very easy. That makes the game a good choice to play with a low-skill friend or relative, but the game is so simplistic that I don't expect it to benefit much from a harder difficulty.

I'm not going to make this longer because there really isn't a lot to say about such a short game. It has no imagination, no excellence, but it fails nowhere. It looks fine, the gameplay is smooth and serviceable, it should be dirt-cheap today, and all in all we had a great four hours and don't regret one penny.
